themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying calls for 'national priority' economic policies, remigration, and immediate deportations. From Spain to Germany, Sweden, Norway, and the UK, conservative and far-right factions share anti-immigration framing to mobilize voters ahead of legislative votes and local contests.

countries.note: Proposes sending deported migrants to third countries such as Rwanda or Somalia.

countries.note: Bars former Conservative MPs from shaping immigration policy to maintain hardline credibility.

themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Far-right and populist parties in Europe and South America are leveraging electoral momentum to pressure center-right rivals and challenge ruling coalitions. In Spain, Germany, France, Argentina, and Hungary, right-wing leaders are flexing political leverage in high-stakes election buildups and parliamentary contests.

countries.note: Warns the center-right PP of tough coalition negotiations while seeking to capitalize on pre-election momentum.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland

countries.note: Positions Marine Le Pen early for the 2027 presidential race while polling ahead of traditional rivals.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Mobilizes provincial and youth congresses to build grassroots momentum for future elections.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Right-wing movement leaders in multiple democracies face heightened legal scrutiny, prosecutor-led investigations, and judicial restrictions. Parties in Brazil, France, Poland, and the United States frame these legal measures as politically motivated persecution or state overreach.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Subject to police raids and judicial investigations over alleged leaks from interior ministry officials.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Clashes with government over Constitutional Tribunal resets and prosecutor suspensions.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Faces judicial injunctions and court rebukes over executive detention and administrative practices.

themes.title: Pensions Overhaul and Fiscal Populism Debates
themes.blurb: Economic populism dominates right-wing policy debates, with leaders promising fiscal relief, tax amnesties, or pension rollbacks to win working-class approval. National debates in France, Italy, Argentina, and Hungary highlight tension between fiscal austerity demands and populist spending pledges.

themes.title: Gamified Pop-Culture Tactics and Digital Propaganda
themes.blurb: Right-wing figures and campaigns are leaning into pop-culture touchstones, AI-generated content, and online youth trends to reach new audiences. From video game debates over GTA VI in France and the US to AI promotional stunts in Argentina and mock newspapers in the UK, digital strategy is driving political outreach.

countries.note: Conservative online networks react heavily to gaming culture trends and digital entertainment.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei uses AI-generated videos and custom lion-branded Cybertrucks to engage tech-oriented youth.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
